title: Special Beef Rendang Curry
description: This is a special beef recipe from my country, Brunei, which is really tasty. The dried shrimp is an added flavor and modification I made to the original dish. Serve with steamed or spiced rice.
ingredients: 0.5 cup red curry paste, or to taste
1 fresh red chile pepper, finely chopped

steps.text: This first step is to soften the beef. Place the beef in a medium saucepan, and add enough water to cover the meat. Cover, and simmer over low heat for at least an hour. Remove the beef from water, and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add in the garlic and dried shrimp, and stir fry for a few seconds before stirring in the lemon grass and onions. Reduce heat to medium, and stir in coconut milk, red curry paste, turmeric, and chile pepper. Mix in the beef, and cover the wok. Simmer for 10 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in the cilantro just before serving. Save some cilantro for garnishing on top if you like.

video.description: Slow-simmered beef gets an infusion of flavors from shrimp, lemongrass and onions before being enveloped in a luxurious coconut milk and red curry paste. Cilantro adds an element of freshness just before serving. This Malaysian favorite is perfect for a satisfying weeknight dinner.
